hero.hero-badge: Micro-badge text indicating location availability and meeting preference. Must include {{CITY}} and {{STATE}}. Max 8-10 words.

h1.h1-text: Primary role title/profession (e.g., 'Machine Learning Engineer', 'Data Engineer'). Max 3-5 words.
h1.h1-suffix: Core value prop suffix highlighting direct access or deployments (e.g., ', direct access, real deployments'). Max 4-6 words.

hero.hero-sub: Introductory paragraph explaining what the specialist builds and deploys for businesses in {{CITY}} and {{STATE}}. Exactly 2-3 sentences.

stat-chip.b: Stat metric number or duration (e.g., '5+', '12+', '24h', '48h'). Max 1 word.
stat-chip.span: Stat metric label (e.g., 'Years building ML', 'Case studies'). Max 2-3 words.

btn--primary.text: Action-oriented primary CTA button text (e.g., 'Discuss your ML project'). Max 4 words.

btn--ghost.text: Secondary ghost CTA button text (e.g., 'View case studies'). Max 3 words.

hero.hero-note: Trust note on meeting logistics, response time, and NDA protection. Must include {{CITY}}. Max 1 sentence.

route-card.route-title: Title of the direct-access comparison card (e.g., 'Who sits between you and the build'). Max 7 words.

route-node-you.b: Title of the client node (e.g., 'Your business').
route-node-you.span: Client needs description (e.g., 'The problem, data and goals').

route-node-me.b: Title of the independent specialist node (e.g., 'Me, directly').

route-node-other.b: Title of agency comparison node (e.g., 'Agency route').
route-node-other.span: Multi-layer agency description (e.g., 'Account manager, then a lead, then a builder').

trust-item: Short trust signal or certification badge (e.g., '100% Upwork Job Success', 'NDA before any data'). Max 4-5 words.
